paper.title: Pure Exploration for a Good Policy in Reinforcement Learning with Bandit Feedback

settings.name_in_paper: Good Policy Identification (GPI) in episodic MDPs, fixed confidence
settings.out_of_scope_reason: Episodic MDP / reinforcement learning (tabular finite-horizon MDP with unknown transitions); pure exploration over deterministic policies.
unmapped: Tabular episodic MDP with S states, A actions, horizon H; unknown transition kernels and initial distribution; deterministic known rewards r_h(s,a) in [0,1]
Arms are deterministic policies; each episode the learner executes a policy and observes the full trajectory
Goal: output a policy with value >= threshold mu_0 if V* > mu_0, else declare None if V* < mu_0 (delta-PAC); instances with V* = mu_0 excluded
Learner knows state and action spaces, the reward function R, threshold mu_0 and delta
settings.definition_quote: An instance of the Good Policy Identification (GPI) problem is specified by the tuple $\nu = ( \mathcal{S}, \mathcal{A},\mu_0, \delta, H, R, P, \mathsf{p})$... We assume $\mathcal{S}, \mathcal{A}, \mu_0, \delta, H, R$ are known to the agent, while $P, \mathsf{p}$ are not known.

algorithms.name: BEE-GPI (Balanced Exploration-Exploitation for Good Policy Identification)

symbols.Delta_V: V*_0(s_0) - mu_0 (gap of optimal value to threshold)

source.label: theorem:upper-bound-of-Etau-recycling-pos
source.quote: On a positive instance $\nu$ where $V^*_0(s_0) > \mu_0$, BEE-GPI (Algorithm 1) satisfies \mathbb{E}[\tau] \leq O\left(\frac{H^2\log\frac{1}{\delta}}{(V_0^*(s_0)-\mu_0)^2}\right) + O\left(\frac{ (H+1)^4SA\log\frac{SAH}{(V_0^*(s_0)-\mu_0)^2} + (H+1)^4S^2A\log\left(HSA\right)}{(V_0^*(s_0)-\mu_0)^2}\right).

results.notes: Algorithm is delta-PAC (Theorem 1). Expected stopping time (number of episodes). Per-round computation solves KL-constrained optimistic planning; polynomial assumed.

symbols.Delta_V: |V*_0(s_0) - mu_0| = mu_0 - V*_0(s_0) for negative instances

source.label: theorem:upper-bound-of-Etau-recycling-neg
source.quote: On a negative instance $\nu$ where $V^*_0(s_0) < \mu_0$, BEE-GPI (Algorithm 1) satisfies \mathbb{E}[\tau] \leq O\left( \frac{(H+1)^4[SA\log\frac{1}{\delta}+S^2 A \log\log\frac{1}{\delta}]}{(V^{*}_0(s_0)-\mu_0)^2}\right) + O(...)

results.notes: Main-text statement recorded; appendix restatement has a slightly different log-log form (log(log(SAH)+log(1/delta)+log(H^2/gap^2))).
